ModMetaData.name: RJW Comfort
ModMetaData.author: umrae
ModMetaData.description: Adds a Comfort work type using native RJW jobs, eligibility checks, preferences and completion hooks. Includes adult-only eligibility, ideology-based treatment, resource collection and optional reuse of Cumpilation resource/conversion definitions. Version 1.1.0 shares lazy map searches, tracks exact jobs, cleans up interrupted sessions and accounts for partial resource placement.
